messages:
Priya Shah: Hi all! Priya here  starting today as Growth PM in the SF office (PST). I bring terrible puns, a tiny succulent named Miso, and a borderline unhealthy love of spicy ramen. Quick Qs: are plants okay at desks? Any neighbors who want to trade snacks? And when's trivia night? :)

Jen (People Ops): Welcome Priya! :tada: Plants are fine (just avoid messy soil on carpet). Trivia night is next Wed at 6pm in the lounge  we'll add you to the RSVP list. Onboarding intro with Ava is on your calendar at 2pm. DM me if benefits paperwork doesn't show up.

Luis Gomez: Hi Priya  desk 4B is yours near the window. I'll leave a small saucer for Miso. For power, each desk has one outlet; bring a labeled power strip if you need extras and we can mount a cable anchor.

Ava Brown: Welcome to Growth! :wave: We'll add you to the planning board and the weekly async sprint notes. Ramen run tomorrow at noon — meet at reception? I'll grab you.

Samir Patel: Welcome! If you bring ramen, I bring the hot sauce selection. :hot_pepper: Also pro tip: instant miso + leftover coffee mug = perfect desk lunch.

welcome-bot: Account setup complete: slack, email, and GitHub. You were added to channels: #social, #growth, #random. Onboarding checklist items pending: payroll form, laptop pickup, security training link.

Priya Shah: Amazing, thanks everyone. I'll bring a tiny flag for Miso and some instant ramen for Friday. Who do I ping for a monitor arm?

Luis Gomez: Ping me here or DM and I'll arrange one. We keep a few spares in the storage closet.

Ava Brown: Also FYI we do a casual "walk-and-talk" every Friday at 12:30 for SF folks. Good chance to meet people.

Priya Shah: Perfect  I'll see you at noon tomorrow. Really excited to be here! :sparkles:
